ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE M.NAGAPRASANNA  ORAL ORDER Heard Sri. Ashok Hande, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners, Sri. Thejesh P., learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri. Kiran Kumar N., learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
2. The petitioners are before this Court calling in question the proceedings in C.C.No.3616/2023 registered for offences punishable under Sections 498A, 504, 506 read with Section 34 of the IPC.
During the pendency of the proceedings, the parties to the lis have settled the dispute among themselves and have filed a joint memo along with an affidavit.

The joint memo reads as follows:
"JOINT MEMO
The petitioner No.1 and Respondent No.2 submit that all their matrimonial disputes between them are settled out of court and there is no existing dispute between them.
They are living together happily along with their daughter at pune since February 2024.
The Respondent No.2 herein submits in view of the settlement all proceedings in C.R.No.204/2022, charge sheet, CC.No.3616/2023 pending before First Addl.
Chief Judicial Magistrate Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru may be quashed by allowing the above petition in the interest of justice and equity."

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate Bengaluru Rural, Bengaluru
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. In the light of the settlement arrived at between the parties, I deem it appropriate to accept the joint memo and close the proceedings on the score that husband and wife have begun to live together now.

5. For the aforesaid reasons, the following:
ORDER i. Criminal Petition is disposed.
ii. Proceedings in C.C.No.3616/2023 pending before the I Additional Chief Judicial NC: 2024:KHC:41087 Magistrate (ACJM), Bangalore Rural, Bangalore Rural District, stands quashed qua the petitioners.
